name: Captivate
description: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages. The target is unaffected if both the user and the target are the same gender, or if either is genderless. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability are immune.
flags: Blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, and if not a Status move, King's Shield.
Bounced back to the original user by Magic Coat or the Ability Magic Bounce.
Can be copied by Mirror Move.
